# Local2PDF

> Local2PDF is a privacy-first PDF toolkit. Supported tools process selected files locally in the browser and do not upload document contents to Local2PDF servers.

## Official information

- [About](https://local2pdf.com/about): Operator, product identity and official facts.
- [Security](https://local2pdf.com/security): Local processing architecture and limitations.
- [Privacy](https://local2pdf.com/privacy): Data handling, analytics and advertising.
- [Terms](https://local2pdf.com/terms): Terms of use.
- [All PDF Tools](https://local2pdf.com/pdf-tools): Complete tool directory.

## Core tools

- [Merge PDF](https://local2pdf.com/tools/merge-pdf): Combine multiple PDFs locally.
- [Split PDF](https://local2pdf.com/tools/split-pdf): Separate PDF pages.
- [PDF to JPG](https://local2pdf.com/tools/pdf-to-jpg): Render PDF pages as images.
- [PDF to PNG](https://local2pdf.com/tools/pdf-to-png): Lossless PDF page rendering.
- [PDF to Text](https://local2pdf.com/tools/pdf-to-text): Extract embedded text.
- [Image to PDF](https://local2pdf.com/tools/image-to-pdf): Convert images to PDF.
- [Rotate PDF](https://local2pdf.com/tools/rotate-pdf): Rotate PDF pages.
- [Reorder Pages](https://local2pdf.com/tools/reorder-pdf-pages): Rearrange PDF page order.
- [Delete Pages](https://local2pdf.com/tools/delete-pdf-pages): Remove unwanted pages.
- [Extract Pages](https://local2pdf.com/tools/extract-pdf-pages): Extract selected pages.
- [Add Page Numbers](https://local2pdf.com/tools/add-page-numbers-to-pdf): Add pagination.
- [Compress PDF](https://local2pdf.com/tools/compress-pdf): Reduce PDF file size.

## Important limitations

- Processing capacity depends on the device and available browser memory.
- Editing a signed PDF can invalidate its digital signature.
- PDF to Text only extracts selectable text — scanned/image-only PDFs produce no output.
- Very large PDFs may require closing other browser tabs for reliable processing.
